bundle.shortDescription: Desktop workspace for qualitative research: transcription, OCR, text analysis and RAG chat over your collections, with remote AI providers.
bundle.longDescription: EntropIA Lite is a desktop research workspace for document and audio collections. It transcribes audio, extracts text from documents via OCR, runs text analysis and offers a RAG chat over the resulting knowledge base. All AI features run through remote providers (OpenRouter, AssemblyAI, GLM-OCR); no local models or runtime are installed.
